name: vgi
description: ATTACH a VGI worker as a DuckDB catalog and query it in SQL. The database identifier you pass to `ATTACH` is the *catalog name* the worker advertises — a single worker can serve several catalogs — while the worker itself is selected with the `LOCATION` option. Once attached, the worker's schemas, tables, and table functions are queryable like any local database, joins and aggregates included. `LOCATION` accepts an HTTP(S) URL for a hosted worker, or an executable path / `launch:` spec for a worker VGI runs as a local subprocess. Any options VGI doesn't recognize are forwarded to the worker and validated against the attach-option specs that catalog declares, so each worker can accept its own attach-time options.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Where the worker lives: an HTTP(S) URL for a hosted worker (e.g. `https://host/vgi/`), or an executable path / `launch:` spec for a worker VGI runs as a local subprocess. May instead be embedded in the database identifier as `'<catalog>?location=<worker>'`.

parameters.name: secrets
parameters.description: Whether to auto-register the remote secret provider a worker advertises in its attach response, reusing this catalog's identity. Set `false` to opt out.

parameters.name: bearer_token
parameters.description: Bearer token sent to the worker. Avoid inlining it in query text where you can.

parameters.name: oauth_refresh_token
parameters.description: OAuth refresh token used to seed silent authentication for this catalog (see [`vgi_oauth_tokens`](#vgi_oauth_tokens) and [`vgi_oauth_identity`](#vgi_oauth_identity)).

parameters.name: data_version_spec
parameters.description: Pin the catalog to a specific data-version specifier the worker advertises, instead of the latest.

parameters.name: pool
parameters.description: Whether subprocess workers for this catalog are pooled and reused across attaches. Applies to executable / `launch:` LOCATIONs.

parameters.name: pool_max
parameters.description: Maximum number of pooled subprocess workers to keep for this catalog.

parameters.name: pool_timeout
parameters.description: Idle time, in seconds, before a pooled subprocess worker is shut down.

parameters.name: worker_debug
parameters.description: Enable verbose worker-side debug logging for this catalog.
